regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad (69% eligible) rotation with Gold Miners as the dominant narrative-leader, but momentum rank-IC is weak and the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (which does help here). Backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines with a near-total unscheduled-surprise share, but the top-most theme candidates are precautionary-resource (gold/silver/copper), so the market-level narrative and the sector heat are not aligned.
emerging_watch: Watching Silver & Royalties for a possible confirmed leadership handoff from Gold Miners: a handoff would show Silver & Royalties' score exceeding Gold Miners' for two consecutive detector prints while both remain eligible. Retire the watch if Gold Miners' margin over Silver & Royalties widens beyond 1.0.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead the narrative with the highest momentum score (2.14), a strong durability_bar of 0.82, a trend-tagged hurst, and full breadth (1.0) without being crowded. The absolute-trend gate, the one validated leg, flags it eligible and trend-healthy. Lean is a direction, sized by the allocator, on the premise that the trend gate continues to avoid the shake-out path.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate validates drawdown/vol control on this market (gate_helps=true)
theses.dissent: Gold Miners can gap down hard on a single USD/real-rate or central-bank surprise; momentum rank has no forward alpha, and high durability can mean the trend is late-stage and extended.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 20-day moving average before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Challenger to Gold Miners with a strong score (1.77), eligible under the trend gate, and full breadth. It is the second leg of the precious-metals leadership structure and not crowded, so it can retain trend exposure without reflexivity risk.
theses.dissent: Same metals-beta risk as Gold Miners, and a mixed hurst suggests the trend is less clean; if gold corrects, silver and royalties often fall faster.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gives up half its 30-day gain before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Crowded (z=1.11) with a high score but lower durability (0.76, mixed hurst). The crowding flag is a size-down caution only, so rather than fade or short, the accountable read is to avoid adding here while the crowding texture persists.
theses.dissent: Copper demand from electrification/industrial policy could keep the trend alive even in a crowded market, and crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO breaks above its prior 52-week high on rising participation before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
